hypothesis: An optional compact per-request source-count bound can prevent renderer overflow without the input-size regression of the earlier verbose resource guidance. Capacity does not establish semantic support or usefulness.

implementation.eligible_requests: No declared current/prior conflict; every eligible decision base and singleton fits the existing renderer limits.
implementation.bound: Largest common k whose k longest complete escaped source blocks, separators and actual decision-specific bases fit every eligible decision. If no positive common bound exists or a base is unmeasurable, preserve the original messages.
implementation.wire_change: Only reduce existing sources.maxItems in response_schema and decision_contracts; no extra prompt text, source removal, quote clipping, new facts, gold/ID filtering or changed runtime validator.
implementation.authority: Prompt guidance only. The unchanged final renderer still validates the actual plan and preserves mandatory conflicts. Model selects relevant support, not the helper.
implementation.conservatism: A common count bound may exclude feasible combinations of smaller sources; report this rather than calling it an optimal semantic subset.

offline_acceptance: Default/false messages and rendering remain byte-identical for archived requests.
Enumerate all source subsets under the bound for escaped text, unequal sizes, USER corrections and renderer flag combinations.
No positive cap for an unrenderable singleton, oversized decision base, current conflict or inherited unresolved conflict; retain original enforcement.
Archived four-source failure has a smaller feasible bound; do not count authored subset rendering as improved model quality.
All archived request/repair payloads stay within the current input guard; no prompt growth.
HTTP mock verifies the actual optional gateway payload, same references/identities and final renderer rejection when the model ignores guidance.

planned_live_comparison.same_native_index: docs-only-dev-coverage-v1, 18 sources / 36 chunks, current main ranking, lexical_hash_v1
planned_live_comparison.common_flags: decision_contracts, source_selection_reminder, source_gap_handoff, source_gap_investigation and repeated-query repair ON; resource_guidance OFF
planned_live_comparison.ordering: First round A/B/C, second C/B/A; arm order balanced within each family.
outcomes: supported material claims and necessary answerable questions
planned_live_comparison.interpretation: Small exposed answer-informed dev comparison, not final/held-out evaluation. Full route or fewer overflows alone is not improved answer quality; human usefulness remains unscored.
planned_live_comparison.stop_policy: Fresh finite scopes only after source/input/index/full-ledger preflight. Preserve both old unknown holds, global halt, USD4.50 ceiling and all old revocations. Any new uncertainty, unexplained accounting or changed input/source stops the campaign; no replacement or resumed identities.
